tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Find or list published posts. Returns slug, title, description, canonical URL, Markdown URL and last updated date for each match, newest updated first, without the post body. Use this first to discover slugs, then call get_post_markdown for the full text. Matches query case-insensitively against tit

tools.name: get_post_markdown
tools.description: Return the full Markdown of one post, with YAML frontmatter, as served at /<slug>.md. Use when you already have a slug from search_posts. To read many posts at once, use get_llms_txt with full set to true instead.

tools.name: get_llms_txt
tools.description: Return the site llms.txt index: what the site covers, every post with its Markdown URL, and other agent entry points. With full set to true, return llms-full.txt, which includes every post body. Use for a whole-site overview or bulk reading, not for finding one post; use search_posts for that.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_posts, get_post_markdown, get_llms_txt · Public sink: search_posts, get_post_markdown, get_llms_txt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_posts, get_post_markdown, get_llms_txt · Public sink: search_posts, get_post_markdown, get_llms_txt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
